summary: SES S.A., the Luxembourg-domiciled satellite operator listed in Paris and Luxembourg (SESG), furnished a Form 6-K on September 15, 2026 attaching a press release dated September 13, 2026. The release announced the successful launch of the eleventh, twelfth and thirteenth O3b mPOWER satellites aboard a SpaceX Falcon 9 from Cape Canaveral, completing the second-generation MEO constellation that already had 10 operational spacecraft. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor or transaction terms were stated; the satellites are expected operational by mid-2027. This is an ordinary operational update, not a special situation, though the release references the completed Intelsat acquisition.
